item.title: Why Leica’s New Sensor Could Redefine Its Image Quality Legacy
item.description: Leica cameras are renowned for their exceptional image quality and durability. The company's venture into the luxury camera market has helped it pave the way for itself to become a giant in its own right. To push this further, it now appears that Leica is keen on making a true 'Made in Germany' camera, with the announcement of building an in-house sensor. This is exciting, as the next device the company will launch is the highly anticipated Leica M12.

item.title: A Note for Every Attention Farming Photographer on Reddit
item.description: Sometimes photographers forget that models are human beings. And truthfully, it seems like lots of photography on Reddit, Instagram and other platforms is embodying this exact idea. Social media thrives on an attention economy and in the same way that photographers abuse and misuse models, big social media companies abuse photographers for their own algorithms. Think about the last time you tried to create an image without a sultry, attractive woman in it. Do you even know how to do that?

item.title: The NASA Nikon Cameras That Made History
item.description: Nikon has created some historic cameras over the years, some going into larger productions, while others were created specifically to meet the demand of that time. One example is the first digital prototype the company created for NASA in the late 1980s. A cutting-edge technology of its time, the Nikon device was one of the biggest milestones, not just for Nikon but for the history of the medium.

item.title: The G6 Thumb Camera Will Change The Reason Why You Take Pictures
item.description: Put your hand over your heart and truthfully answer the question - why do you take photographs these days? item.title: By Appointment Only: We’re Doing Portfolio Reviews
item.description: Social media algorithms tend to value video over photographs. That means that you're going to have to find a way to make your images that much more impactful. It's true, a single photo can get a whole lot more interaction and engagement than a random video with the same AI generated voice and music that you see on social media. So we're doing individual portfolio reviews here at the Phoblographer by appointment, and for a pretty affordable price point.

item.title: The Kodak Camera That Launched Photojournalism’s Digital Era
item.description: Kodak has been one of the few companies that have changed the face of photography. From the Brownie camera that made the more accessible to the launch of Kodachrome film, whose colors are still revered today, the company introduced some exciting innovations. What most people forget is that Kodak was also responsible for pioneering the digital camera in 1994, which was specifically designed for news photography. Here is a look at what you are missing out on.

item.title: Dear Camera Manufacturers: Please Take This Seriously
item.description: This is a list of ideas and things that manufacturers should do in order for them to keep the camera world fresh. The past few years have felt like one manufacturer basically copying the other over and over again. And it has made the camera and photography world so incredibly dull.
